name: Mirror
source:
A hallucination that frequently torments Manson. She is part of the Furniture Women trio.

[Spoiler]The trio were constructed by Manson's subconscious to be his friends, and are devoted to steering him the "right" path, even to the detriment of his mental health. In the best endings, Mirror vanishes. In Dorothy's route, she gains the name Heather.[/spoiler]
